title: COLLATOR: Compositional Multi-Agent Orchestration with Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.14483v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible foundation for multi-agent systems, but their effectiveness and computational cost depend critically on orchestration design. Across different tasks, role design, capacity assignment, and dependency construction jointly affect both solution quality and execution efficiency. Existing approaches automate parts of this design process, yet they often optimize these decisions partially or sequentially, and rely on execution-level feedback that provides limited credit assignment for local orchestration decisions. We propose LEMON (Learning Executable Multi-Agent Orchestration via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning), an LLM-based orchestrator that learns to design efficient multi-agent orchestration. translated_title: COLLATOR：基于反事实强化学习的组合式多智能体编排
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）为多智能体系统提供了灵活的基础，但其有效性和计算成本在很大程度上取决于编排设计。在不同任务中，角色设计、能力分配和依赖关系构建共同影响解决方案质量与执行效率。现有方法实现了这一设计过程的部分自动化，但它们通常只对这些决策进行部分优化或顺序优化，并且依赖于执行层面的反馈，而这类反馈对局部编排决策的信用分配能力有限。我们提出了LEMON（Learning Executable Multi-Agent Orchestration via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning，通过反事实强化学习学习可执行的多智能体编排），这是一种基于大语言模型的编排器，能够学习设计高效的多智能体编排。给定一个任务，LEMON会设计一个统一的编排规范，将定制的智能体职责、能力级别和依赖关系组合在一起。为了训练该编排器，我们对编排……
tldr: 该论文提出LEMON，一种通过反事实强化学习训练的基于大语言模型的编排器，能够为给定任务统一设计包含智能体职责、能力级别和依赖关系的高效多智能体编排，从而同时提升解决方案质量与执行效率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LEMON, an LLM-based orchestrator trained via counterfactual reinforcement learning, which designs efficient multi-agent orchestration by jointly composing agent duties, capacity levels, and dependency relations to improve both solution quality and execution efficiency.
